Run BANKSY clustering independently for each slice

run_banksy_individual.Rd

Run BANKSY clustering independently across normalisation methods and spatial slices.

Usage

run_banksy_individual(
  norm_list,
  methods = names(norm_list),
  assay_name = "logcounts",
  cluster_col = "banksy_cluster",
  k_geom = 15,
  lambda = 0.8,
  resolution = 0.2,
  seed = 123
)

Arguments

norm_list

Named list containing normalised SpatialExperiment objects.

methods

Optional character vector specifying the normalisation methods to analyse.

assay_name

Name of the assay used by BANKSY.

cluster_col

Name of the colData column used to store BANKSY cluster assignments.

k_geom

Number of spatial neighbours used by BANKSY.

lambda

BANKSY spatial weighting parameter.

resolution

Resolution parameter used for clustering.

seed

Random seed for reproducibility.

Value

Named list with the same structure as `norm_list`. BANKSY cluster assignments are added to the colData of each SpatialExperiment object.

Details

BANKSY cluster assignments are added to the colData of each SpatialExperiment object so that the same objects can be used in downstream clustering evaluation, plotting, differential expression, and GO enrichment analyses.

The function supports either:

  • a named list of SpatialExperiment objects, or

  • a named list where each method contains a named list of SpatialExperiment objects corresponding to multiple slices.
